about: Named landmarks on the anchor photo, each tied to one of his parts (3D grounding, step 2).
coords: picture px, x right, y down; pixel (c, r) covers [c, c+1) x [r, r+1)
sides: named by HIS side: his left = the picture's right = the room's +X

eye_his_right.how: centre of his whole eye: a smooth oval fitted to the eye's own edge (measured in 180 directions to a fraction of a pixel; 145/180 kept: the rest ran into lashes, his black eye ring or fur over the eye; fit rms 1.66 px) and passing through the point where his eye meets his lash line (there, dark meets dark: no edge to see) at [347.0, 426.0]. 2026-11-19, owner: the earlier oval stopped short of the top of his eye

oval.note: an eye is round; seen at an angle it shows as an oval. short/long is a depth clue (how far the eye faces away from the camera), used in step 4

eye_his_right_catchlight.how: brightness-weighted centre of the brightest spot inside the eye (the light's reflection)

eye_his_left.how: centre of his whole eye: a smooth oval fitted to the eye's own edge (measured in 180 directions to a fraction of a pixel; 158/179 kept: the rest ran into lashes, his black eye ring or fur over the eye; fit rms 1.28 px) and passing through the point where his eye meets his lash line (there, dark meets dark: no edge to see) at [687.0, 403.0]. 2026-11-19, owner: the earlier oval stopped short of the top of his eye

oval.note: an eye is round; seen at an angle it shows as an oval. short/long is a depth clue (how far the eye faces away from the camera), used in step 4

eye_his_left_catchlight.how: brightness-weighted centre of the brightest spot inside the eye (the light's reflection)

nostril_wing_his_right.how: outer end of the nose's dark shape (tools/whisker_chains.py measure_pads), whole pixels; the shape fades out gradually there

nose_y_centre.how: where the two sides of his nose meet and the philtrum starts (the middle of the Y)

philtrum_bottom.how: bottom of the philtrum, where his mouth splits

mouth_corner_his_right.how: outer end of the mouth's dark line, whole px

lip_corner_his_right.how: corner of the approved whisker-pad outline at his lip line

chin_midline.how: the approved head line where it crosses his midline (under his mouth)

ear_tip_his_right.how: topmost point of the approved ear outline

ear_base_inner_his_right.how: inner end of the approved ear base (a notch in his outline)

ear_base_outer_his_right.how: outer end of the approved ear base (a notch in his outline)

ear_tip_his_left.how: topmost point of the approved ear outline

ear_base_inner_his_left.how: inner end of the approved ear base (a notch in his outline)

ear_base_outer_his_left.how: outer end of the approved ear base (a notch in his outline)

crown_front.part: top of his head (the strip joining his ears)
crown_front.how: his outline at the middle of the strip joining his ears
crown_front.note: owner: the strip is the top of his head seen from above; here his head's top starts going back, so this point is where the camera's line of sight grazes it

fold_midline.how: the approved lower fold where it crosses his midline

peet_bottom_his_right.how: lowest point of the approved peet outline (where it meets the floor)
peet_bottom_his_right.note: used to put the floor under him; a rounded peet touches the floor near here

peet_bottom_his_left.how: lowest point of the approved peet outline (where it meets the floor)
peet_bottom_his_left.note: used to put the floor under him; a rounded peet touches the floor near here

peet_mark_his_left_1.how: small dark mark on the peet (contrast 47.3 grey levels, 51 px)
peet_mark_his_left_1.note: a mark on his fur, so a fixed point of him if it shows in another photo

peet_mark_his_left_2.how: small dark mark on the peet (contrast 38.7 grey levels, 22 px)
peet_mark_his_left_2.note: a mark on his fur, so a fixed point of him if it shows in another photo

belly_front.note: owner: the tuft is his belly seen from below; it carries on back underneath him

floor_contact_midpoint.how: midpoint of his two peets' lowest points: the room's origin is on the floor under here
